parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description:
The live streaming domain name.
- You can specify a single domain name or multiple domain names. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,).
- If this parameter is left empty, the merged data of all live streaming domain names is returned by default.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

parameters.name: Interval
parameters.description:
The time granularity of the queried data. Unit: seconds. Valid values:
- 300
- 3600
- 86400

If you do not set this parameter or set it to an unsupported value, the default value 3600 is used.

parameters.name: SplitBy
parameters.description: The grouping key. Default value: domain,region,drm_type. You can specify one or more of the following values: domain, region, and drm_type. Separate multiple values with commas (,). Set this parameter to an empty string or null to disable grouping by these keys.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. The minimum data granularity is 5 minutes.
